name: scoped-change-delegation
description: Delegate a scoped code change to a worker agent in an isolated checkout, gate the handoff on planner approval, and require a checkable evidence trail before the change is accepted.

steps.description: Define the scoped code change to hand off to a worker agent.

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: Repository the worker will check out (e.g. github.com/example-org/example-repo)

inputs.name: file_scope
inputs.description: Glob(s) the worker is allowed to touch, e.g. src/payments/**

inputs.name: instructions
inputs.description: What the worker should change, and why

steps.description: Planner must approve handing this scope off to a worker agent before it starts.
steps.prompt: Review the scope collected above. Approve to delegate it to a worker agent running under the declared isolation and prompt contract, or reject to keep it with the planner.

steps.description: Placeholder for the worker's own tool calls while it makes the change in its isolated checkout. Those calls are not modeled as SOP steps — evidence.required is what makes them checkable after the fact, against the worker's actual event trace.
Emit the delegation record (approved) or a hold record (rejected).
steps.run:
set -o pipefail; jq -r '
  if ((."gate-delegation".decision // "reject") == "approve") then
    "## Delegation Record\n" +
    "**Task:** " + ((."collect-scope".task_title // "(untitled)") | tostring) + "\n" +
    "**Repo:** " + ((."collect-scope".repo // "?") | tostring) + "\n" +
    "**Scope:** " + ((."collect-scope".file_scope // "?") | tostring) + "\n" +
    "**Risk:** " + ((."collect-scope".risk // "?") | tostring) + "\n" +
    "**Planner (self-reported):** " + ((.inputs.planner // "?") | tostring) + "\n" +
    "**Decision:** approved\n\n" +
    "_Delegated to a worker agent under `independent-checkout` isolation and the `code-change-worker` prompt contract. Certify this run against the declared `evidence.required` events, not against this record._"
  else
    "## Delegation Record\n" +
    "**Task:** " + ((."collect-scope".task_title // "(untitled)") | tostring) + "\n" +
    "**Decision:** rejected — not delegated.\n"
  end
' <<< "$OSL_CONTEXT" | jq -Rs '{delegation_record: .}'
